title: Lazy dequant dispatch and kernel coalescing for streaming decode latency
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Dequantization overhead and precision-switching penalties are dominating tail latency for streaming decode on INT8/FP8 model variants, especially for short-turn interactive requests that heavily reuse KV caches. Goal: Reduce end-to-end decode latency by deferring or eliding full dequant operations and by coalescing kernel launches across adjacent small batches while preserving numerical stability for top-k sampling.

Approach: Implement a lazy-dequant dispatch layer that tracks tensors' quantized provenance and only materializes dequantization when an operation absolutely requires full FP32/FP16 values (e.g., final layer norm, softmax). Combine this with a kernel coalescer that merges small decode steps and amortizes kernel startup for attention+ffn sequences when sequence lengths and token counts permit. Add conservative mixed-precision fallbacks for operations known to be precision-sensitive and a stochastic dequant elision mode for A/B experiments to measure real-world quality impact.

Constraints: Must be compatible with existing KV-cache streaming semantics and not change public API behavior. Needs to interoperate with GPU fused kernels and existing quantized kernel registry. Latency wins should not come at >0.5% quality regression (measured by n-gram overlap/LL evals) for our curated prompt set.

Deliverables: runtime changes (dispatch and coalescer), unit/e2e tests covering correctness with cached KV reuse, perf microbench harness, and an experiment dashboard tracking latency/quality/cost trade-offs.
acceptance_criteria: Median decode latency for 1-3 token responses reduced by >=12% on G5-like hardware compared to current INT8 path
Tail (p99) latency reduced by >=8% across mixed short/long sequences
Quality regression <=0.5% on our eval set (LL and top-k sampling metrics), verified in rollout canary
No regressions in KV cache correctness (existing cache-consistency tests pass)
Ability to toggle lazy-dequant and kernel coalescer independently for experiments
